description: Covariance push-forward correctness with kinematic attribution. The block is subjected to a prescribed uniform deformation ramp: every face is displacement-controlled so the interior target deformation gradient is F_target = diag(1.5, 1.0, 0.8). The scorer fits a local deformation gradient from submitted positions for kinematic realization, then scores pure covariance transport against each entrant's exported internal F_i Sigma_0 F_i^T. Requires trajectory.parquet deformation gradients and covariances.parquet with at least frame 0 and the final frame.

all_faces.note: x(t) = (I + ramp(t) * (F_target - I)) x0 prescribed on all six faces; the homogeneous solution satisfies the same map in the interior

pass_criteria.reference: fit local F_i from positions and compare it with F_target for kinematic realization; compare sigma_final with entrant-native exported F_i * sigma_rest * F_i^T for transport

provenance.reference_formula: Sigma' = F Sigma F^T, the push-forward of a Gaussian covariance under the linear map F (continuum kinematics of an affine deformation)
regime_assumptions: interior deformation homogeneous (guaranteed by prescribing the affine map on all faces of an elastic block)
homogeneity is only approximate within 2 particle spacings of a prescribed face, so the scorer excludes those particles and says so
provenance.notes: Tolerances are looser than pure floating-point arithmetic would demand because near-boundary disturbances can propagate slightly inward; the exclusion zone plus median/p95 metrics keep the test sharp without punishing benign boundary noise.
